note: Signature outfits for the 13 NPCs. NPC-only: never shown in the player's Style menu. 2x2 atlas grid (front/right on top row, back/left on bottom row); applied at runtime by assets/npc-outfits.js.

outfits.name: Lyla's Safari Vest
outfits.description: Khaki safari photojournalist vest with olive cargo pockets and a leather camera strap, over khaki cargo pants.

outfits.name: Chip's Showman Jacket
outfits.description: Deep purple showman jacket with gold lapels, gold buttons and a gold star, over black trousers with gold stripes.

outfits.name: Barnaby's Shop Apron
outfits.description: Tan canvas shop apron with price-tag motifs over a red checkered shirt, with brown trousers.

outfits.name: Pip's Party Jacket
outfits.description: Rainbow-striped carnival jacket with confetti dots and gold buttons, over confetti-sprinkled white trousers.

outfits.name: Agnes's Cat Sweater
outfits.description: Cream cable-knit sweater with orange tabby cat faces and paw prints, over brown corduroy trousers.

outfits.name: Dottie's Floral Cardigan
outfits.description: Dusty-rose cardigan with cream and sage florals and pearl buttons, over a cream blouse and brown trousers.

outfits.name: Peggy's Work Flannel
outfits.description: Red-and-black buffalo plaid flannel with a leather tool belt and hammer loop, over tan work trousers.

outfits.name: Coinsworth's Pinstripe Suit
outfits.description: Navy pinstripe vest with a gold pocket-watch chain, white shirt and red tie, with navy pinstripe trousers.

outfits.name: Fern's Garden Overalls
outfits.description: Sage-green overalls with embroidered leaf and flower patches over a terracotta shirt, with brown cuffs.

outfits.name: Stanley's Postal Uniform
outfits.description: Postal-blue shirt with gold badge and navy mailbag strap, with navy trousers with a red side stripe.

outfits.name: Bobby's Fishing Vest
outfits.description: Olive fishing vest with lure pockets and fly patches over a red plaid shirt, with khaki wader trousers.

outfits.name: Mayor's Showman Jacket
outfits.description: Crimson sequined showman jacket with gold lapels, epaulets and a gold star medallion, over black trousers with gold stripes.

outfits.name: Gideon's Patchwork Coat
outfits.description: Eccentric patchwork tour-guide coat in teal, mustard, burgundy and paisley with visible stitching, over brown trousers.
